name: WiZ Color A19 60W E26 Wi-Fi bulb (US)

radios.note: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi with Bluetooth Low Energy (used for setup).

matter.note: The product page lists Matter over Wi-Fi; the 3-pack of the same bulb says Matter certified. CSA lists WiZ 'LED lamp - Full color' certificates, but we could not tie one to this exact product code.

apple_home.note: Added to Apple Home via Matter; WiZ says this needs iOS 16.1+ and a home hub such as a HomePod mini or Apple TV.

google_home.note: Works through WiZ's Google Home integration; Matter is also possible.

alexa.note: Works through the WiZ Alexa skill; Matter is also possible.

smartthings.note: WiZ lists Samsung SmartThings among compatible platforms; Matter is also possible.

home_assistant.note: Official WiZ integration (local push). Requires 'Allow local communication' in the WiZ app, which is on by default.

hubRequired.note: For bulbs, this means needing a bridge or hub for basic app control. The bulb joins Wi-Fi directly and is controlled from the WiZ app.

localControl.note: Home Assistant's WiZ integration controls bulbs over the LAN (local push).

colorType.note: Full colour plus tunable white from 2200 to 6500 K.

lumens.note: 800 lm nominal at 8.8 W (60 W equivalent).

summary: The WiZ 60W A19 colour bulb (product code 046677603441) is a US E26 bulb rated at 800 lumens, with full colour and white from 2200 to 6500 K. It uses 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi plus Bluetooth for setup, so no hub is needed. Alexa, Google Home and SmartThings work through WiZ's own integrations, and Apple Home works via Matter.
caveats: Apple Home needs Matter and an Apple home hub (HomePod mini or Apple TV).
